patch.value: Add a secure agent-first execution surface that resolves exact Jellyfin OpenAPI operations, validates methods paths parameters and bodies, defaults to read-only behavior, preserves all structured output formats, and strengthens executable API coverage evidence without replacing intuitive typed commands.

Give humans and agents complete forward-compatible Jellyfin API reach with exact contract evidence.
Eliminates the gap between fuzzy coverage claims and executable operation access while keeping private auth and mutation safety boundaries.
Every live OpenAPI operation can be resolved and safely invoked through a structured CLI contract, with read-only acceptance and honest quality evidence.
The live mapper reports 100 percent semantic coverage, but prior PM evidence correctly says that is insufficient to claim complete implementation.
